From: Laura Chen <laura@heliohealth.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.example.com
Date: Sat, 4 Jul 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal kickoff — HelioHealth (HL-4921)

Hi Chloe,

Hope you had a great week. Our renewal for HL-4921 comes up in late August and the team wants to get a kickoff going so we can align on a revised term, proposed burst capacity for our Q4 testing window, and the QBR timing.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm new term options (12 vs 24 months) and how stair-step pricing would work.
- Agree a burst capacity runway: target +2.5x throughput for 6 weeks during load testing.
- Calendar a QBR in August with the execs and SREs.
- Any required security evidence (SOC2, data retention) we should raise with procurement now.

Can you kick this off and propose next steps? I can loop in Mike (platform lead) on the technical details.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
VP, Infrastructure
HelioHealth

Chloe/David — I can make 9:30. Quick commercial notes to prepare for the external kickoff:
- Two formal options: 12mo standard renewal (baseline uplift pricing) or 24mo with a stepped commit (5% discount on year 2 and predictable burst credits).
- For a temporary +2.5x burst for six weeks we can offer a burst credit package priced as a one-time prepay or as a billed overrun at 1.6x standard token rate — preference to prepay for budget certainty.
- We may have authority to offer a modest one-time credit (up to 7%) if they sign a 24mo commit before Aug 15. I'll confirm limits with revenue ops.
